svg.title: Six families of persona-based agents embedded regulatory, security and PII controls across the banking software lifecycle
svg.desc: Anonymous banking case study showing how persona-based agent families connected requirements, architecture, engineering, security, compliance and quality assurance while producing continuous audit evidence.
svg.text: AI support across a regulated software delivery lifecycle
Six agent families automated delivery, security, compliance and evidence across the SDLC
PII, security and regulatory needs were reinterpreted
Functional, security and compliance testing fragmented
Evidence was assembled after the work
Audit preparation added delay and rework
Translated banking rules into delivery controls
Requirements carried regulatory, PII and security obligations forward
Deployed six families of persona-based agents
Specialized teams covered delivery, security, compliance and quality
Functional, security and compliance checks ran throughout delivery
SIX AGENT FAMILIES ACROSS A REGULATED SDLC
The bank accelerated delivery by making security, compliance and evidence part of the engineering flow
